note: new split resplit-1117; Argus-V-em = mean of three repeats at epoch 67; mixed / period / tool / tool3 are AUROC: mixed = all calls compared, period = same collection period, tool = same tool (every tool with a violation and a normal call), tool3 = same tool, only tools with three or more visible violations and normal calls; caught / recall / precision / f1 / accuracy = the yes/no judgement of the test calls at the threshold at which 5% of the validation normal calls alarm; period lean = October normal calls ranked above November normal calls (0.5 = not at all)
